Calculate indoor and outdoor human exposure to biting

Source: R/database.R
calculate_exposure.Rd

Calculates indoor and outdoor proportions of human exposure to mosquito biting, based on activity patterns and mosquito endophagy / endophily parameters.

The relevant proportion is used as the exposure argument of calculate_impact() / run_interventions(), which reduces the effective coverage (coverage * exposure); it does not modify the intervention efficacies (unlike AnophelesModel version 1). Typically Exposure_Indoor_whileinbed for ITNs; for IRS, see below.

For IRS, two choices are defensible: the mosquitoes resting indoors (indoor_resting, the endophily) or the bites received indoors (Exposure_Indoor_total). They describe different pathways and agree only when both shares are equal; neither is wrong in itself. The OpenMalaria export offers the same choice (get_OM_ento_snippet(irs_exposure = ), default "indoor_resting"): use the same one in both routes.

Usage

calculate_exposure(activity_cycles, vec_p)

Arguments

activity_cycles

List with time-series attributes: HBI, HBO, humans_indoors, humans_in_bed.

vec_p

List of vector-specific entomological parameters (see def_vector_params).

Value

List with proportions of overall exposure:

  • Exposure_Indoor_total

  • Exposure_Outdoor_total

  • Exposure_Indoor_whileinbed

  • Exposure_Outdoor_whileinbed

  • indoor_resting
